Join the Circle Book a Consult

Myth vs. truth — gentle clarity

Myth

Essential oils are a cure-all.

Truth

Aromas can support comfort, mood, and ritual. They should be used thoughtfully, safely, and as part of a broader wellness practice.

Myth

More is better.

Truth

Dilution and context matter — high concentration can irritate skin or overwhelm the senses.

Foundations of the practice

Safety-first

Dilution guidance and patch testing are integral to every recommendation.

Personalized blends

Your history, preferences, and context shape each blend.

Ongoing care

Memberships prioritize ongoing adjustments over one-off products.

Stories from sessions

Rest ritual

A traveler found a nightly roll-on that eased evening transition. We tweaked dilution and delivery for bedtime comfort.

Focus blend

A student used a mid-day inhaler to create a calm focus ritual during exams; small, repeatable acts built confidence.

Home reset

A family introduced a room mist for ritualized debriefs at dinner; scent cues supported gentle transitions.

Gift membership

A thoughtful membership helped a friend establish daily self-care with curated blends shipped quarterly.

Frequently asked — practice safety

How do you handle dilution?

I provide dilution tables and prep guidance for each blend. For topical blends I typically recommend 1–3% for adults unless otherwise discussed.

Do I need a patch test?

Yes — patch testing is recommended for new blends. Instructions are provided with every bespoke order.

What about pets and pregnancy?

I offer pet-aware and pregnancy-aware alternatives. We avoid certain notes and delivery methods; full safety guidance given in consults.

Ready to begin?

Become a member for gentle, ongoing aromatic care — blends delivered, support on hand, rituals that evolve with you.

Curated blends — recipes for ritual

Below are thoughtfully composed blends. Each entry lists top/middle/base notes, an aroma profile, and what it gently supports. Safety notes included; please follow dilution and patch-test guidance.

1 — Calm Harbor

Top: Bergamot, Lemon
Middle: Lavender, Roman Chamomile
Base: Vetiver
Aroma profile: bright-herbaceous to soft-earthy. Supports evening wind-down and mindful breathing.

2 — Morning Focus

Top: Grapefruit, Peppermint
Middle: Rosemary, Basil
Base: Cedarwood
Aroma profile: crisp-green with a resinous anchor. Supports alertness for short bursts of concentration.

3 — Gentle Ground

Top: Sweet Orange
Middle: Rose Otto (low %), Geranium
Base: Sandalwood
Aroma profile: floral-citrus softened by creamy woods. Supports contemplative moments and ritual journaling.

4 — Cozy Hearth

Top: Clove bud (very low)
Middle: Cinnamon leaf (very low), Cardamom
Base: Benzoin, Patchouli (light)
Aroma profile: warm-spicy-sweet. Use sparingly and with low dilution; supports seasonal ritual and ambient warmth.

5 — Breath Ease (diffuser blend)

Top: Eucalyptus (use with care)
Middle: Niaouli
Base: Ravensara
Aroma profile: fresh-camphorous. For short, well-ventilated diffusions; supports a sense of clearer breathing in context but is not a treatment.

6 — Sleep Silk

Top: Mandarin
Middle: Lavender, Ho Wood
Base: Frankincense
Aroma profile: soft-citrus into resinous calm. Supports a pre-sleep ritual—best in a roll-on at 2% dilution or diffuser at low concentration.

7 — Comfort Companion

Top: Lemon balm CO2 (if available)
Middle: Palmarosa
Base: Jojoba (carrier-forward blend)
Aroma profile: green-floral with a soft herbaceous base. Intended for topical application in mild dilutions to support grounding routines.

8 — Creative Spark

Top: Bergamot
Middle: Ylang ylang (low), Clary sage
Base: Amyris
Aroma profile: bright-floral-earthy. Use as a short inhalation ritual to invite a playful, creative frame of mind.

9 — Gentle Immune Support (aromatic only)

Top: Lemon
Middle: Tea tree (very low)
Base: N/A
Aroma profile: fresh-herbal. For diffusion only, brief periods; not a substitute for healthcare. Avoid with children and specific sensitivities—consult before use.

10 — Evening Unwind

Top: Mandarin, Petitgrain
Middle: Lavender, Melissa (low)
Base: Cocoa absolute (trace)
Aroma profile: tender-citrus to honeyed-vanillic. Great for baths or pillow mists; observe dilution guidance and fabric-safe instructions.

Safety & guidance

Dilution: Typical topical dilutions range from 0.5–3% for adults depending on sensitivity and use. Children, pregnancy, and reactive skin require tailored, lower dilutions.

Patch test: Always perform a patch test for topical applications. Apply a diluted amount to the inner forearm and wait 24 hours for any reaction.

Pregnancy & pets: Certain oils are avoided during pregnancy and some can be harmful to animals. If you are pregnant or have pets at home, book a consult so we can choose pet- and pregnancy-safe alternatives.

I do not make medical claims. These blends are offered to support rituals and sensory comfort; they are not medical treatments.
